items.rationale: The topic is the bigger one, so 남동생은 comes first. The weaker side takes 보다: 저보다. Then 더 and 커요. Option a swaps the two sides. Option c puts 보다 as a separate word before the noun. Option d mixes 가장 with 보다.
A superlative uses 제일 or 가장 before the adjective and has no 보다. Option a is a comparative with no second noun and means only 'faster'. Option b mixes 제일 with 보다.
너는 is the topic (you). 지수보다 means 'than Jisu'. 더 빨라요 means 'is faster'. An answer that says Jisu is faster reverses the sides (M4).
보다 means 'than' and attaches to the end of the noun that you compare against: 너보다.
The topic with 는 is the one that has more. 저보다 marks the speaker as the one with less. Option b reverses the sides.
